_note: The far terraces' pebble tables: one on each of three terraces of the stepped hillside at the island's southern tip, placed by hand on the plate's own earthworks, each with its long side along its terrace; explorer [x, z], metres. half: the paved ground levelled for it; rot: the direction of its long side; ground: the terrace's height; rise: the step up to the terrace above.
